subtasks.title: Average the two middle values
subtasks.description: In stats.py, median() returns s[mid] for every length. For even lengths it must return the mean of s[mid - 1] and s[mid].

input.new:
mid = len(s) // 2
    if len(s) % 2 == 0:
        return (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2
    return s[mid]

input.summary: Even-length median averages the two middle values.
